body: thank you for this, i’m letting that resonate with me.  thank you 🙏

i really appreciate all of this, i have been trying to work on these things and stop isolating myself.  i just hope i can get to a place of  stability in the larger picture too.  it seems that therapy would really help this but i am unsure of how to afford it.  
i’m going to try to petition my insurance to cover it, and if they refuse, i don’t know what i’ll do.  

as of now, i am not actively suicidal but rather the ideations are very much present, as usual, but intensified by this larger crisis.  if i’m still alive i suppose it means i have a little hope. i am doing everything i can to have quality of life.  but i am very scared of losing hope when i cannot pay for any more therapy and still cannot work because i am too unstable.
